description: Citation chip UX scaffold: click citation -> open viewer at cited page -> render fail-closed highlight overlay using locked citation polygons (anchors-first for RH2).

userStories.title: Click citation chip -> open viewer at cited evidence
userStories.description: Render citation chips from citation_ids and navigate to the viewer at the correct document_id and page.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-001 Report rows render citation chips derived from citation_ids only (no free-text citations).
AC-002 Clicking a chip navigates to the viewer with the correct document_id and page (1-indexed).

userStories.title: Evidence highlights align across zoom + rotation
userStories.description: Render highlight overlay that stays aligned across zoom and rotation, and fail closed when invariants break.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-003 Highlight aligns at 100% zoom for at least one commitment anchor and one survey anchor (pack_01).
AC-004 Highlight remains aligned at 50/100/150% zoom and bbox scales with zoom (within ±2% OR ±3 CSS px vs bbox100*scale) (or an explicit cut is enforced: verified at 100% only).
AC-005 Highlight remains aligned on at least one rotated/scanned page (pack_07) (or an explicit cut/patch is enforced).
AC-006 Fail-closed: invalid polygon or wrong page yields explicit failure UI and no overlay.
